name: Smoke Creeper

items.name: Smoke Vision
items.text: The smoke creeper ignores the Concealed condition from smoke.

items.name: Smoke Form
items.text: The smoke creeper can move through the spaces of other creatures but can't end its movement in the same space.

items.name: Choking Swoop
items.text: The smoke creeper Flies up to its Speed, moving through the spaces of other creatures and leaving traces of itself behind. Each breathing creature it passes through must attempt a DC 23 Fortitude save save. On a failure, the creature inhales part of the elemental and is Immobilized for 1 minute by the pain of the smoke rasping in its throat and lungs. A creature can attempt to end this condition by spending an action coughing and succeeding at a DC 23 Fortitude save save.

items.name: Painful Exhalations
items.text:
Requirements At least one creature within 40 feet is Immobilized from the smoke creeper's Choking Swoop

---
Effect The smoke creeper flaps its wings, violently drawing the lingering smoke free from all creatures immobilized from its Choking Swoop within 40 feet. Each target must attempt a DC 23 Fortitude save save. On a failure, the creature is Enfeebled 1 for 1 minute and Sickened 1 (Enfeebled 2 and Sickened 2 on a critical failure). Regardless of the result, the creature is no longer immobilized from the smoke creeper's Choking Swoop.

text:
Smoke creepers shift and modify their appearance as they float through the Plane of Air, but they prefer to take on a vaguely insectile form with wings trailing choking fumes and glowing red eyes.

---
Some elementals embody aspects of air, such as smoke, lightning, and fog.
